recommendation: Keep the no-change audit commit. Future expansion failures for this value set should be handled as terminology tooling/cache validation, not by changing the source binding away from 736542009.
issue_request: FHIR-19296 was a Published/Persuasive FHIR-core Pharmacy request to change the Medication and MedicationKnowledge drug form binding to 736542009, Pharmaceutical Dose Form (dose form), for R5.
initial_application: Commit 51ce8a822f639be478cea8655beab71f95afb6ab changed the Medication form value set from 421967003 to 736542009. Commit 634360b51d40494b5427df25cc2ecce831d928e4 made the parallel MedicationKnowledge value-set change, and the Jira comment links merge commit b60fb4b7d3fe218dfc65fc253645e4c6c79d4708.
additional_context: FHIR-22272 was closed as a duplicate of this issue after reporting the same mismatch. FHIR-20185 rejected using basic dose form instead. Later FHIR-24700 and FHIR-25441 described a 736542009 expansion failure, but the recorded resolution and Zulip discussion identify that as a tooling/cache issue rather than a source binding reversal. In current fhir.ini, Medication is active in [resources]; MedicationKnowledge is not active there, and its retained source copy already uses 736542009.
reconciliation: No source change was made. Medication.doseForm binds to http://hl7.org/fhir/ValueSet/medication-form-codes, that value set filters SNOMED CT descendants of 736542009, and no 421967003 reference remains in the Medication or MedicationKnowledge source directories.

related_jiras.note: Reported the same medication-form-codes mismatch and was closed as a duplicate of FHIR-19296.

Reported the post-change expansion error and was resolved no-change because FHIR-25441/tooling fixed it.
Recorded the 736542009 expansion problem as a Published technical correction/tooling issue, not a source binding change.
